softwareProjectPricing: For software and app projects, we quote the full project upfront, then break the cost into phases. Clients pay to start each phase, not the whole project at once — so you only pay for the next phase once you've approved the last one. Exact quotes depend on project scope, so direct anyone asking for a number to WhatsApp for a proper conversation.

academy.model: Pay As You Learn. Every modular course is broken into individual steps. On that course's own page, visitors can choose to take the full course at once (best overall value) or build their own plan by selecting just the steps they want, starting with whatever fits their budget. Every step earns its own Digitanotion Step Certificate, and finishing every step in a course also earns the Full Course Certificate. Steps are recommended in order since later steps often build on earlier ones, but nothing is locked — visitors are free to start wherever they like.
academy.certificationJourney: Learn → Do (hands-on labs) → Score 70%+ on a capstone → Certify → Experience (internship placement) → Grow (alumni network).

modularCourses.name: Cybersecurity Foundations
modularCourses.overview: A beginner-friendly start into cybersecurity — no prior experience needed. Covers the fundamentals, safe information-gathering, networking, real security tools, common threats, and ends with a personal career roadmap.

steps.title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
steps.summary: The very first step — what cybersecurity actually means and why it matters to everyone, not just tech people.
highlights: Core cybersecurity concepts in plain language

steps.title: Finding Information Safely (OSINT)
steps.summary: How professionals gather public information the legal, ethical way — and how to spot when someone's trying to trick you online.
highlights: What OSINT means and how it's done ethically
Basic techniques used by investigators and ethical hackers

steps.title: Networking Basics & Security
steps.summary: How devices talk to each other over a network, and how to keep that connection safe.
highlights: How networks and the internet work
Key terms: IP address, router, firewall

steps.title: Linux OS Basics & Artificial Intelligence
steps.summary: Hands-on with the tools real security professionals use daily, plus how AI is changing the fight against cybercrime.
highlights: How AI is used in modern threat detection

steps.title: Understanding Threats & Weaknesses
steps.summary: How real attacks happen, using relatable examples — and how experts find and fix weak spots first.
highlights: What a 'vulnerability' is and how it's found

steps.title: Finding Your Career Path
steps.summary: The closing step — turning everything learned into a real, personal cybersecurity career plan.
highlights: Cybersecurity specialisations explained (Ethical Hacking, SOC Analyst, Digital Forensics)
Matching strengths to the right career path

modularCourses.name: Ethical Hacking
modularCourses.prerequisite: We recommend completing Cybersecurity Foundations first, or having equivalent experience.
modularCourses.overview: An advanced, hands-on penetration testing specialization — legal frameworks and methodology, tool mastery, network and web application attacks, mobile security, and a full capstone penetration test with a professional report.

steps.title: Introduction to Ethical Hacking
steps.summary: The legal frameworks, mindset, and methodology every real penetration tester starts with.
highlights: Legal and ethical frameworks of hacking

steps.title: Kali Linux & Tools Mastery
steps.summary: Becoming fluent in the operating system and toolkit every professional penetration tester relies on.

steps.title: Network Penetration Testing
steps.summary: Real network attacks in a safe, isolated lab — from first scan to full exploitation.

steps.title: Web Application Security
steps.summary: Breaking (and fixing) web applications the way bug bounty hunters and pentesters do, following the OWASP Top 10.

steps.title: Mobile Security
steps.summary: Extending skills into mobile — how attackers find and exploit weaknesses in Android and iOS apps.

steps.title: Contracts, Compliance & Capstone
steps.summary: Bringing everything together in a full, simulated corporate penetration test with a professional client report.
highlights: Presenting findings like a real consultant

modularCourses.name: SOC Analyst 1
modularCourses.prerequisite: We recommend completing Cybersecurity Foundations first, or having equivalent experience.
modularCourses.overview: A hands-on entry into Security Operations Center work — real SIEM tools, alert triage, incident response, and network/endpoint monitoring, ending with career and certification guidance.

steps.title: Introduction to the SOC
steps.summary: What a Security Operations Center actually does, day to day, and where a Tier 1 Analyst fits in.
highlights: What a SOC is and why it matters
A day in the life of a SOC Analyst

steps.title: Security Monitoring & SIEM Tools
steps.summary: Hands-on with the software every SOC Analyst uses to monitor systems in real time.
highlights: What a SIEM tool does, in plain language
Setting up basic detection rules and alerts

steps.title: Threat Detection & Alert Triage
steps.summary: The exact process real analysts use to decide whether an alert is nothing or a real problem.
highlights: Telling false positives from real threats

steps.title: Incident Response Basics
steps.summary: The calm, structured process professionals follow once a threat is confirmed real.

steps.title: Network & Endpoint Security Monitoring
steps.summary: Watching network traffic and individual devices for the subtle signs of compromise.
highlights: Reading network traffic for suspicious signs

steps.title: SOC Career Path & Certification Prep
steps.summary: Turning everything learned into a real career plan, including which certifications are actually worth it.
highlights: Certifications that matter for a SOC career
Writing a resume that gets noticed
